book.name: 2 KORIN
book.title: KORIN KHRISAWBU KHATEI PAUL CAKUA UIHNINGNAH

content: Vaicung kaa ung nápaw

Ma khazaw letei kaa ungnahpaw kaa pung, thlangda hratah a cangpaw heh chehthlah a cang tihtah mehnung kih tah sah lypaw, Khazing tah a sahpaw ing, chaizaw ing cawh vaicung letah kaa hnui tah cawh kaa hni.
Macawtaco alui thlangda letah kaa ung chung tahei vaicung taitah a hreisah kaa cang nápaw khah vang peh ka, a hrungthe tah kaa ung tei.
Zecawtamaw tatah vaicung kaa ing taitah a hreisah ka cang titah co, thlekalong tah ung khawh a bei peh.

Zemaw tah pawco ma pungsaw lehei kaa ung chung taco hmingrih tah ma nai ka, a hrung thimi tah cang peh ka, thlekalong tah ung cawh kaa dupaw cang lytah vaicung ing khah a hreisah cang peh seh la, ma co thih a thaipaw pungsaw cawh hringnah tah thlai seh takhah kaa dupaw a cang.
Ma ruapaw taco ma tua katei, amakhang cawtah A Thlawpaw a ma peitu cawh Khazing heh a cang.
Macawtaco kaa rae a chah paria thlang, taico pungsaw lehei kaa ungchung vytei heh cawh Abuipaw khatah ka hlah he peh tah zong kaa hni.
Taico kaaning cawh mehmuh ná tah cang lytah zingná tah a hringpaw ka cang he peh.
A cang, kaa lung cawh a cy. Ma pungsaw taihei piahly tah Abuipaw khatah va ung cawh kaa du vy sylypaw a cang thlang.
Macawtaco pungsawpaw ing letah kaa ung zong tah cang seh, vaicung taitei ing letah kaa ung zong tah cang seh, Abuipaw a lawngsah heh kaa du caipaw a cang.

Zecawtamaw tatah pungsaw tah kaa ung chung tah achawpaw cang seh, achiapaw cang seh, kaa tuapaw hming naning cy khei a mai hmuh kaw rua pawtah Khri a hme letah biapace pawtah ka chuh cy hrahring tae he peh.
Arainah cawtah raihrenah

Mataico, Abuipaw cizaw cawh zemaw a cang takhah kaa hni cawtah khei cawngsaw laipasong khah ka zawng he peh. Khazing tah kaa cangnah vytei heh ma hnih thlu thlang ka, naaning zong tah naa chiachaw thluidangnah lungthing tah naa ma hni thlang tatah hnabeisuinah ka hnui.

Naaning khatah kaaning le kaaning a pachaw kaa zawngpaw peh cang lytah naaning tu tah a ma palaikhui he seh tatah caichaw kaa ca pehpaw he a cang. Ma pawsui co aa lungthing chung letei a ungpaw hming letah pachawnah navy tah alailang tah hmuhpaw hming cung letah pachaw a dupaw sahlo aa bia khah naa paleh khy he a.
Kaa thinglung heh a mori caco Khazing rungnawnah cawtah cang ka, ahmang pawtei a cang caco, naaning naa cawtah a cang.
Ze kaa tua zong tah Khri donah tah kaaning cawh a ma siachai thah. Zecawtamaw tatah ming vytei cawtah pakheh a thi tah cawh hnih peh ka, macawtaco ming vytei cawh a thipaw a cang hrah he.
Taico ming vytei cawtah a thihpaw cawh a hringpaw sahlo tah aaning aa cawtah hring khawh lytah aa cawtah thi katei, patho kaw a cangpaw Zisu cawtah aa hring nápaw cawtah a cang.

Macawtaco atoning taihei co aho cung letah hmai khazaw tei a pacangpaw phung hrakhei pacang khawh bei peh. Khri khah uikheh cawh ma hrakhei kaa za pacang naná tah atoheh cawh ma hraco pacang khawh bei peh.
Macawtaco ahohmai Khri tei a cang caco, ama cawh tua thapaw mehnung a cang, ahlungpaw cangnah khah ly ka, a thapaw cangnah khah a va chuh myca.
Ma hming vytei a tuatu cawh Khazing cang ka, Khri thongtah Ama khatah a ma raisah ka, Ama le ming hringpaw sahlo kaa letah a rainah raihre ruapaw zong a ma peh.

Ma cawh Khazing tah Khri letah cawngsaw vytei khah Ama khatah a raisah myca he ka, cawngsaw khah aa suanah cawtah sua phosah khawh bei he. Taico ma a rainah bia heh ming hringpaw sahlo ching pawtah rai a ma peh.
Macawtaco, kaaning cawh Khri aly lang a seipaw cang he peh ka, Khazing tah kaaning hmang tah bia a ca caw he. Khazing khatah a rainah tua pawtah Khri vypaw tah ka ca naw he.
Khazing taco suanah a hnui lypaw Khri khah kaa cawtah suanah a thuihlainah tah a tua. Ma cawh Ama a thongtah Khazing hme letah mehding kaa cang khy nápaw cawtah a cang.
